# Serve Corvane Institute

Ines's institute service: a seat on the data governance board, a seat on the sequencing core user committee, and the policy and agreement work that follows from both. It has no end date because the seats are renewed every three years and the policies keep needing maintenance.

## Scope

- Data governance board: data access requests, institute data policies, data protection impact assessments brought by [[victor-lindahl]], and agreements with external data holders such as the [[northern-cancer-registry]]. See [[data-governance-board-membership]].
- Sequencing core user committee: prices, turnaround, instrument procurement and the queue rules of the core run by [[rafael-ibarrondo]]. See [[sequencing-core-user-committee]].
- Institute resources the group depends on but does not own: the [[corvane-biobank]] and the registry linkage.
- Out of scope: the group's own data management plan ([[lab-data-management-plan]], under [[lead-tumour-evolution-group]]) and Halo consortium governance (under [[halo-consortium-work]]). Where they meet, the service side is filed here and the consortium side there.

## Current State

- The [[data-access-policy-revision]] is the live item. Draft 3 with the consortium transfer clause was discussed at [[data-governance-board-2026-09-10]] and not adopted; it returns at the board on 2026-11-12. Until then the group cannot move pseudonymised St Aldric data into the Halo benchmark environment, which blocks external validation for the [[mrd-manuscript]].
- The [[registry-linkage-agreement]] was signed on 2025-10-31 and is in its first year. The first refresh under it feeds the [[registry-linkage-update]].
- Ines has declared two industry contacts on the institute conflict-of-interest register ([[ben-whitfield]], [[ravi-vellanki]]) and recuses from board items involving their companies. See [[conflict-of-interest-handling-vendor-contacts]].
- Ines's board term runs to 2027-03-31; renewal is a conversation with [[margarethe-sell]] in early 2027.

## Active Projects and Workflows

- [[data-access-policy-revision]] (Active)
- [[registry-linkage-agreement]] (Completed; the agreement itself is now an operating resource described in [[registry-linkage-agreement-summary]])
- Board papers arrive ten working days before each meeting; Ines reads them with [[yara-castellanos]], who sees most group-related requests from the data stewardship side.
- User committee meets quarterly; the price list ([[sequencing-core-price-list-2026]]) is reviewed once a year.

## Next Actions

- [ ] Get draft 4 of the data access policy into the board papers for 2026-11-12 (papers deadline 2026-10-29).
- [ ] Agree with [[victor-lindahl]] on the scope of the consortium transfer DPIA before the November board.
- [ ] Confirm with [[daniel-asante]] whether registry-derived outcomes may travel under a consortium agreement; see [[can-we-send-pseudonymised-cfdna-data-to-halo-sites]].
- [ ] Bring the buffy coat sequencing price to the next user committee, given the clonal hematopoiesis filter costs.

## Maintenance Log

- 2026-09-10: Board discussed draft 3 of the policy revision; adoption deferred to 2026-11-12.
- 2026-03-16: Data access policy revision opened after the board asked for consortium sharing rules.
- 2025-10-31: Registry linkage agreement signed; project closed.
- 2025-05-22: Board approved the group data management plan.
